scenicChapters.title: Grand Tour of Switzerland
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 36 km this is Grand Tour of Switzerland, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

places-rempart-du-bourg-isolino-virginia.story: A 179 km round trip from Bellinzona - roughly 3 h 05 in the saddle. On the way it passes Sacri Monti of Piedmont and Lombardy, Monte San Giorgio, Isolino Virginia-Camilla-Isola di San Biag and back through Monte San Giorgio. The highest point is about 1,550 m. It crosses from Switzerland into Italy - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. The line favours views over speed.
